entries.title: Psalms 39:1
segments: ¶<<To the chief Musician, [even] to Jeduthun, A Psalm of David.>> I said, I will take heed to my ways, that I sin not with my tongue: I will keep my mouth with a bridle, while the wicked is before me. {my mouth...: Heb. a bridle, or, muzzle for my mouth}

words.text: is before me. {my mouth...: Heb. a bridle, or, muzzle for my mouth}

entries.title: Psalms 39:2
segments: I was dumb with silence, I held my peace, [even] from good; and my sorrow was stirred. {stirred: Heb. troubled}

entries.title: Psalms 39:3
segments: My heart was hot within me, while I was musing the fire burned: [then] spake I with my tongue,

entries.title: Psalms 39:4
segments: LORD, make me to know mine end, and the measure of my days, what it [is; that] I may know how frail I [am]. {how...: or, what time I have here}

words.text: , what it [is; that] I may know
I [am]. {how...: or, what time I have here}

entries.title: Psalms 39:5
segments: Behold, thou hast made my days [as] an handbreadth; and mine age [is] as nothing before thee: verily every man at his best state [is] altogether vanity. Selah. {at...: Heb. settled}

words.text: [is] as nothing before thee: verily every

entries.title: Psalms 39:6
segments: Surely every man walketh in a vain shew: surely they are disquieted in vain: he heapeth up [riches], and knoweth not who shall gather them. {a vain...: Heb. an image}

entries.title: Psalms 39:7
segments: ¶And now, Lord, what wait I for? my hope [is] in thee.

entries.title: Psalms 39:8
segments: Deliver me from all my transgressions: make me not the reproach of the foolish.

entries.title: Psalms 39:9
segments: I was dumb, I opened not my mouth; because thou didst [it].

entries.title: Psalms 39:10
segments: Remove thy stroke away from me: I am consumed by the blow of thine hand. {blow: Heb. conflict}

entries.title: Psalms 39:11
segments: When thou with rebukes dost correct man for iniquity, thou makest his beauty to consume away like a moth: surely every man [is] vanity. Selah. {his...: Heb. that which is to be desired in him to melt away}

words.text: . {his...: Heb. that which is to be desired in him to melt away}

entries.title: Psalms 39:12
segments: Hear my prayer, O LORD, and give ear unto my cry; hold not thy peace at my tears: for I [am] a stranger with thee, [and] a sojourner, as all my fathers [were].

entries.title: Psalms 39:13
segments: O spare me, that I may recover strength, before I go hence, and be no more.

words.text: me, that I may recover strength
